name: public-profile-section
title: Public profile section
description: Edit how others see you: picture, display name, @username with a live availability hint, bio with a counter, links, and a preview that updates as you type.
docs: profile is the saved profile; the draft lives inside until Save, and a new profile passed back replaces it. onSave receives the cleaned-up draft and, when a new picture was chosen, the File to upload as the second argument (profile.avatar of a new picture is only a temporary preview address: store the real URL you get back). onCheckUsername(username) resolves true when the name is free and is only asked for names that follow the rules and differ from the saved one.
